hero.title: Our Instructors
hero.subtitle: Chalak Champs — Instructor Profiles
hero.description: Meet the dedicated team of experts guiding your child's journey to success with passion and care.

instructors.name: Nafis Shahriar
instructors.description: Nafis Shahriar is currently pursuing a BA in Applied Linguistics and ELT. He focuses on clarity, consistency, and practical communication rather than memorization-based learning.

instructors.name: Mahmuda Shawal
instructors.description: Mahmuda Shawal has completed her MA in English. She focuses on creating a positive classroom environment where students can naturally improve their confidence and creativity.

instructors.name: Shanjida Afroz
instructors.description: Shanjida Afroz is pursuing a BA in English Literature and Linguistics. She emphasizes practical speaking, classroom interaction, and confidence-building for real-life communication.

instructors.name: Rubina Akther
instructors.description: Rubina Akther is studying at Shanto-Mariam University. Her teaching style focuses on helping students develop clear pronunciation and strong foundational skills.

instructors.name: Jannatul Ferdows
instructors.description: Jannatul Ferdows is pursuing undergraduate studies in English. She believes consistent encouragement and interactive learning play an important role in student motivation.

instructors.name: Shahrin Sultana Dristy
instructors.description: Shahrin Sultana Dristy is a graduate with 3.5 years of experience. Her classroom approach focuses on leadership, communication, and skill development.

instructors.name: Azwad Akhlak
instructors.description: Azwad Akhlak has over 10 years of experience in art instruction. His teaching approach focuses on imagination, visual creativity, and helping children express ideas confidently through art.
